exposure: Timing of surgical resection for nasal glial heterotopia
cohort: This study involves a 4-day-old female newborn diagnosed with midline subcutaneous extranasal glial heterotopia and a review of 19 published pediatric cases of purely subcutaneous extranasal glial heterotopia.
finding: The review concluded that surgery for nasal glial heterotopia can be safely performed when the child is 6-12 months old, with follow-up recommended until school age.
followup_time: 3 years (for the presented case); recommended until school age (for the general finding)
